panel.name: panel_path_editor

check_box.label: Edit mode
check_box.name: edit_mode_check
check_box.tool_tip: Edit this path in world: click the ground to place a waypoint, drag a node to move it, right-click a node to delete it. Unchecking (or leaving this tab) hands the camera back

panel.text: Click ground to place · drag a node to move · right-click to delete

scroll_list.name: waypoint_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Waypoints in order. Select a row to inspect / highlight that node in world

button.label: Add
button.name: btn_wp_add
button.tool_tip: Append a waypoint at the actor's feet

spinner.label: Height (m)
spinner.name: node_height_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Manual height nudge at this node (m). 0 = feet on the ground

spinner.label: Dwell (s)
spinner.name: node_dwell_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds the actor holds at this node (0 = no pause)

spinner.label: Speed (m/s)
spinner.name: node_speed_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Speed override at this node (m/s). 0 = use the path speed

line_editor.name: node_anim_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Play this animation at the node instead of the walk anim (local only). Blank = walk anim

spinner.label: Speed (m/s)
spinner.name: path_speed_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Nominal ground speed along the path (m/s). Per-node overrides win where set

slider.label: Smoothing
slider.name: path_tension_slider
slider.tool_tip: Corner smoothing (0..1): 0 = tight, near-straight corners; 1 = full flowing curves

spinner.label: Ease in (s)
spinner.name: path_easein_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Accelerate from a standstill over this many seconds at the start

spinner.label: Ease out (s)
spinner.name: path_easeout_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Decelerate to a stop over this many seconds into the final node

check_box.label: Ground-follow
check_box.name: path_groundfollow_check
check_box.tool_tip: Clamp feet to terrain / prims each frame so the walk rides slopes and stairs

check_box.label: Pitch to slope
check_box.name: path_pitch_check
check_box.tool_tip: Tilt the body pitch to the local slope while walking

combo_box.name: path_end_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What happens when the actor reaches the end of the path

text.name: color_lbl
text.tool_tip: This actor's path color in world (auto, from its id)

panel.name: color_swatch
panel.tool_tip: This actor's path color in world (auto, from its id)

check_box.label: Enable path camera (session)
check_box.name: path_camera_enable_check
check_box.tool_tip: When on, the cameras you set on Subject A's path drive the view as that actor walks, so a walk plays as one actor + camera take. Off is a no-op; existing pathing is unchanged. The camera hands back to normal control the moment the walk stops, finishes, is cut, or the actor leaves the region.

button.label: Set camera here
button.name: btn_node_setcam
button.tool_tip: Capture the current camera position, aim and FOV into this node

button.label: Clear camera
button.name: btn_node_clearcam
button.tool_tip: Remove the camera from this node

combo_box.name: node_cam_transition_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How the camera reaches this node. Cut: snap to this shot when the actor arrives. Ease: glide from the previous camera node as the actor walks between them.

button.label: Preview
button.name: btn_node_preview
button.tool_tip: Jump the camera to this node's shot to check the framing, without walking

panel.text: Select a waypoint to author its camera

button.label: Resume
button.name: btn_suspend_resume
button.tool_tip: Resume the walk from where it left off

button.label: Re-anchor here
button.name: btn_suspend_reanchor
button.tool_tip: Move the whole path to the actor's current position and resume from here (keep shooting on this sim)

button.label: Cancel
button.name: btn_suspend_cancel
button.tool_tip: Drop the suspended walk and return to idle
